iti35:2.1: Nayidaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati jana kuhanatthaṃ janalapanatthaṃ lābhasakkārasilokānisaṃsatthaṃ iti maṃ jano jānātū-ti.
iti35:2.2: Atha kho idaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati saṃvaratthañca pahānatthañcā-ti.
